reference_sql:
SELECT product_id,
       product_name,
       unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE category_id = 3
ORDER BY unit_cost_eur, product_id
LIMIT 2
alternatives: SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_cost_eur FROM products WHERE category_id = 3 ORDER BY unit_cost_eur ASC, product_id ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_cost_eur FROM products WHERE category_id = 3 ORDER BY 3, 1 LIMIT 2
SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_cost_eur FROM products WHERE 3 = category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur NULLS LAST, product_id LIMIT 2
